items.heading: A Scribe, Extra Time
items.text: A Scribe, Extra Time A scribe, extra time or both. For a three-hour paper the extra time is 60 minutes. The candidate may choose their own scribe, and the scribe should not hold qualifications in the subject.

items.heading: Competitive Exams Have Their Own
items.text: Competitive exams have their own rules, and the notice for each exam is the final word. These documents give a baseline.
